source: Terrain Tiles on AWS (terrarium, zoom 11, about 56 m here), mostly SRTM
encoding: zlib of little-endian int16 metres, row by row (y south, row 0 north), each value after the first in a row the difference from the one before it
spikes: a source sample over all eight neighbours by more than 60 m is their median

inner.ridge: a vertex over the mean of its four neighbours by more than 4 m takes the highest sample (every 56 m) in its own cell

relief.encoding: R, G = 0.5 + slope east, south / 3.2; B = (occlusion - 0.7) / 0.6; row 0 north
